issues.description: ClaimReview JSON-LD in generate-html.js (line 1513) uses ${counts.total} (our WIN count, currently 72) in the "claimReviewed" field, where it should use ${context.domeClaimedConfirmed} (the dome's own claimed count, 69). This misrepresents what the dome claims: "The dome has 72 confirmed predictions" vs the correct "The dome claims 69 confirmed predictions." The ClaimReview schema is meant to represent the claim being reviewed (dome's own claim), not our entry count.

WIN-053.c12 H0: 'monopole pair' label in paragraph 0 invokes the e^(−r/λ) functional form. A textbook monopole field has Coulomb (1/r²) geometry, not exponential. The operationally-correct topological argument (A,C both positive = same-signed sources; ∇·B=0 forbids closed-loop with same-sign sources) does not depend on the radial form but the label creates a needless attack surface for a defender who knows EM textbooks.

Dome can claim the aperture ratio is exactly 1 (symmetric flux). The sentence defending against this retreat exists but the dichotomy itself is not spelled out.
